name: tile-puzzle
description: Triple Match (Tile Explorer / GD_Test) level-design toolkit. Skill gen-layout creates one symmetry-ranked empty layout from a shape/icon/image (simplifies complex art, matches the source's reflection axes); skill tile-level-design assigns tiles, scores difficulty, and solves/verifies levels; skill display-json-level renders a level JSON into a self-contained browser-playable HTML with real art; skill winrate-target designs/generates a level that hits a target REAL-PLAYER metric (win_rate, play duration, revive %, booster %, near-miss) at an early/mid/late stage, from a model fitted on real play logs. Use together for image-to-playable-level; use winrate-target when the goal is a player-behaviour number rather than a shape.
